plan.title: Coordination-safety: isolate implementer lanes in worktrees; only orchestrator commits main
plan.goal: No two agent lanes ever stage into the same git index: implementer delegations run in isolated worktrees and hand back a patch/branch; only the orchestrator commits to main. Root-cause fix for 3x shared-index contention.
success_criteria: delegate-to-codex + delegate-to-local run the implementer in a fresh isolated worktree by default (--shared escape documented); result handed back as patch/branch, never staged/committed into main
Two lanes dispatched in parallel land via patches with zero shared-index contention (live proof)
Discipline parity-written into all agent instruction files (Rule 16); backstop guard refuses concurrent shared-index staging

phases.name: worktree-isolate delegation scripts
phases.goal: delegations run in isolated worktrees, hand back patch/branch

phases.name: discipline doc + parity
phases.goal: principle in all agent instruction files

phases.name: concurrent-dispatch validation
phases.goal: parallel lanes no longer contend; single-lane regression clean

items.name: worktree-isolate delegate-to-codex + delegate-to-local
items.goal: each dispatch creates a fresh `git worktree add HEAD` (per-task branch delegate/<task-id>), runs the agent with CWD=worktree, hands back a patch/branch (never stages/commits into shared main), tears down + archives the patch; add --shared/--no-worktree escape (default isolated); --check/--status/--list/quota-precheck unchanged
items.validation_goal: a dispatch runs in an isolated worktree + produces a patch/branch; shared main index untouched during it; existing subcommands unchanged; done while no delegation is live
items.editorial_note: core fix; reuse git worktree + the Agent-tool hand-back pattern (Rule 20); coordination-critical infra = top risk-tier, isolated impl + rigorous review

items.name: discipline doc + parity (Rule 16)
items.goal: write the isolate-implementers/orchestrator-only-commit-main principle into CLAUDE/CODEX/LOCAL/GEMINI/WORKFLOW-CANON from one source; update parity matrix
items.validation_goal: all 5 agent files carry it; parity-matrix updated; no lane in isolation

items.name: backstop concurrent-staging guard
items.goal: a pre-commit/coordination check or advisory index-lock that refuses concurrent shared-index staging of another lane's claimed-in-flight paths (cooperative, not a security boundary)
items.validation_goal: a simulated concurrent stage is refused/serialized; test present

items.name: concurrent-dispatch validation + visibility
items.goal: prove two parallel lanes land via patches without index contention; single-lane regression clean; dashboard/QA visibility of active delegated worktrees
items.validation_goal: live concurrent-dispatch proof; regression green; observable
items.editorial_note: closes the loop with live proof
